name: gamenet_spawn_point_list_init_globals
description: GameNetSpawnPointList::InitGlobals clears the spawn-point list globals.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431bf0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431bf0 validates a leaf zeroing of g_GameNetSpawnPointList, g_GameNetSpawnPointTail, g_GameNetSpawnPointHead, and g_GameNetSpawnPointCount.
The native launch smoke first seeds all four spawn-point globals with nonzero values, calls GameNetSpawnPointList::InitGlobals directly, and verifies they are cleared.
